data.content: # Predicted line-ups for Premier League teams in Matchweek 6. Greek winger Christos Tzolis also got injured during the break and is definitely out of the Leeds match, according to Mikel Arteta, which could mean a start for Eberechi Eze. Another Arsenal player who picked up an injury on international duty was Ezri Konsa, opening the door for Cristhian Mosquera to make his first appearance since August in central defence. data.content: # Seven Games In 22 Days Will Show How Far Leverkusen Have Really Come. Saturday's trip to Mainz begins a run of seven games in only 22 days for Carles Martínez's side, a stretch that should provide a much clearer picture of where this rebuilt Leverkusen team actually stands. > "We're missing the points from Elversberg to call it a completely successful start; we need to repeat those three points now in the coming games.". **Seven points from four Bundesliga matches is hardly a crisis.**. A convincing 4-0 response against Union Berlin followed, only for Die Werkself to lose control of the next game against Augsburg and draw 2-2. Leverkusen are still searching for their first away victory of the Bundesliga season, while Mainz have also collected seven points from their opening four matches. According to the sporting director, the team must show more and more of the work from preseason and the start of the season, and play with greater stability at an increasingly high level.
